notes.title: Huge update with a lot of new content
notes.content:
We have heard a lot of your comments about the game being too short. 
It has taken us a loooooot of time and effort, but now we are happy to announce that 3 new solar systems have been added to the game. 9 extra planets and jam instruments and tons of new music. 
Explore circuit bending, Jamaican dub music, echo effects, Dub sirens and music inspired by 70's psychedelic funk music from Beirut. 

We hope you like it.

notes.title: Huge update with 9 extra planets, 3 new solar systems, new music genres and more
notes.content:
This update of Rytmos incluces a huge update with 9 extra planets. 3 New solar systems with each a new music genre to explore. 
Includes circuit bending, Jamaican Dub music and music inspired by 70's psychedelic funk from Beirut.
Lots of fun new instruments to play on and music to explore.  

A lot of people told us the game was too short. We listened and spend a lot of time creating more content, so now you get a significant amount of extra play time. 

We hope you like it.

notes.title: Controller bug fixes
notes.content:
This build contains a few fixes for issues when playing with a controller. 
[list]
[*] You can now replay a puzzle by pressing the x button
[*] There's a quit button in the controller settings menu
[*] Fixed a bug where you could break the game if spamming the controller buttons when exiting jam-mode
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who helped us improve the game by reporting the bugs!
